items.item_text: High school diploma or equivalent (e.g., GED or HiSET).
Minimum of 2 years of experience working in an Anatomic Pathology laboratory.
Experience working in Epic or an equivalent laboratory information system.
As a Hospital Laboratory Technician 2, you will play a crucial role in supporting the operations of our Surgical Pathology Reporting offices. Your primary responsibilities will include:
Manage microscopic slide inventories, including the preparation/packaging of biohazardous waste for pickup by contracted waste management vendors.
Receive, sort, and file microscopic slides.
Pull slides for Tumor Board, conferences, education, pathologist review and other departmental needs.
Visit the offsite warehouse to pull/file materials and package biohazardous waste for waste management transport.
Provide exceptional service to faculty, patients, couriers, and vendors.
Perform daily departmental runs to pickup and deliver slides.
Process tissue requests for clinical trial submissions, continuation of care, and ancillary testing.
Release surgical pathology specimens to patients and manufacturers.
Accessioning pathology cases for add-on immunohistochemistry, special stains, and electron microscopy.
Coordinate with patients, OR Scheduling and clinical teams to schedule bone marrow aspirations.
Perform general office tasks (answer phones, respond to emails, scan documents into the EMR, send/receive faxes).
Digitally scan slides for telepathology applications.
Provide coverage at the Santa Monica and West Valley Surgical Pathology Reporting Offices, as needed.
Capable of meeting physical demands, including standing, walking, reaching, bending, kneeling, ascending/descending, extending/contracting, and rotating/pivoting.
Must accurately read fine print for extended periods.
Ability to provide coverage at Santa Monica and West Valley Surgical Pathology Reporting Offices, as needed.
Familiarity with safe handling and packaging requirements for pathology materials, including glass microscopic slides and formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue.
Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and respond promptly to high-priority requests.
Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and push or pull up to 1200 lbs. of palletized boxes using a pallet jack.
